text: #809, by @gitdek's call on 2026-11-11: a ratified plan is its own decision record. Its file in .invariant/plans holds what a person ratified for one issue, with the ratifier, the date and the exact proposal, and CI checks that ratification on every change, so restating it by hand as a decision adds nothing. The decision graph reads each ratified plan as a node named P- and its issue's number. A line of the SPEC or the docs that links the plan's file, or any line that names its ID, rests on it, and decisions check counts a SPEC bullet that names a ratified plan as traced. Whoever merges a plan's pull request records a decision only for a call the plan doesn't state, and for every one-way door. This closes slice 13 without the follow-up design of #417, #421 and #445, a second pull request for every merged plan with crash recovery of its own, parked since D-0357 because its recovery check is too slow for a gate run. Retiring that design's proved core and its protocol steps is its own change.
